assumptions.choice: The entry comparison uses the highest close of the 252 completed bars immediately preceding the current bar, while the trailing stop uses the most recent 252 closes including the current bar.
assumptions.reason: Including the current close in the high that the same close must cross above would make entry impossible; using the prior established 52-week high is the literal executable interpretation of a breakout to a new high.

assumptions.choice: When the 252-day closing high changes, the existing stop-limit is canceled and replaced after cancellation is confirmed, with stop and limit prices recalculated from the latest observed high.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader orders cannot have their prices modified in place, so cancel-and-replace implements continuous updating without leaving multiple active protective orders.

assumptions.choice: At each entry, buy the greatest whole-share quantity whose closing-price cost plus the broker's configured commission does not exceed the currently available cash.
assumptions.reason: This is the executable whole-share interpretation of allocating 100% of available capital while accounting for the harness commission.
